drank to remove all potion effects

Where do cows get their medicine? At
name: 魔法奶桶

source: Obtained by using a bucket to milk
Shania the Cow in The Hub. Can be
drank to remove all potion effects
and never runs out of milk!
loreParagraphs.translation: 在中心岛用桶给奶牛 Shania 挤奶获得。饮用后可移除所有药水效果,且牛奶永不耗尽!

source: Where do cows get their medicine? At
loreParagraphs.translation: 奶牛去哪里拿药?去农场药房.
